issue.title: decorator: Refactor decorators with ParamSpec.

labels.name: integration review
labels.description: Added by maintainers when a PR may be ready for integration.

repository.name: zulip
repository.description: Zulip server and web application. Open-source team chat that helps teams stay productive and focused.

issue.body:
There are several cases of decorators that can be refactored straightforwardly using `ParamSpec` and `Concatenate`.

Such decorators expect `HttpRequest` as the first argument of the function to be decorated and preserve the function signature without `cast`.

The only difference to the previous behavior is that the concatenated parameter (`request: HttpRequest`) becomes positional-only, as required by PEP 612.

issue.title: decorator: Refactor authenticated view decorators with ParamSpec

repository.name: zulip
repository.description: Zulip server and web application. Open-source team chat that helps teams stay productive and focused.

issue.body:
This refactors some of the view decorators, particularly `authenticated_json_view` and `authenticated_rest_api_view` to be typed with `ParamSpec`. This is intended to be a follow-up work for #22646 so it is already rebased onto it.

Part of the refactorings is to rewrite `rate_limit` as a function that returns nothing. Using `rate_limit` as a decorator that preserves the view function's signature within another decorator is [a use case not properly supported by mypy](https://github.com/python/mypy/issues/12909). The behavior is equivalent except that now `rate_limit` is no longer a decorator.

This also extracts `public_json_view` from `authenticated_json_view` to more accurately type views that might accept requests from unauthenticated users, which naturally expects `Union[UserProfile, AnonymousUser]` as the second parameter instead of `UserProfile`.

Errors affected:

```diff
5c5
< Found 78 errors in 25 files (checked 1406 source files)
---
> Found 79 errors in 25 files (checked 1406 source files)
15a16
> zerver/decorator.py error Argument 2 has incompatible type "Union[UserProfile, RemoteZulipServer]"; expected "UserProfile"  [arg-type]
```
(Fixed in #22648)

issue.title: Allow use of both `@trace` and `@tag_args` stacked on the same function

labels.name: T-Task
labels.description: Refactoring, removal, replacement, enabling or disabling functionality, other engineering tasks.

repository.name: synapse
repository.description: Synapse: Matrix homeserver written in Python/Twisted.

issue.body:
Allow use of both `@trace` and `@tag_args` stacked on the same function

```py
@trace
@tag_args
async def get_oldest_event_ids_with_depth_in_room(...)
  ...
```

Before this PR, you would see a warning in the logs and the span was not exported:
```
2022-08-03 19:11:59,383 - synapse.logging.opentracing - 835 - ERROR - GET-0 - @trace may not have wrapped EventFederationWorkerStore.get_oldest_event_ids_with_depth_in_room correctly! The function is not async but returned a coroutine.
```


Split off from https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/pull/13440


### Dev notes

I understood what our decorator function was doing after looking at a simpler example in https://stackoverflow.com/questions/44169998/how-to-create-a-python-decorator-that-can-wrap-either-coroutine-or-function
